title: OpenAI Cuts Prices 90% and the Model Did It Itself
description:
OpenAI just started a price war 🔥

A million tokens is now 20 cents in, $1.20 out. Tasks that run you a dollar elsewhere cost about six cents here. Terra fell 20%, Sol didnt move.

Wildest part: GPT 5 6 Sol optimized its own GPU code in the cloud, 20% faster kernels and 15% quicker text gen. It literally made itself cheaper to run 😅✨

#ai #chatgpt #claude #claudecode #gemini
